primaryChecks.text: So Joash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
primaryChecks.previousContext: But Amaziah would not listen; for it was of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought after the gods of Edom.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Judah was defeated by Israel; so every man fled to his tent.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 初出節の地理用法を確認。常時表示の要約はこの節で確認できる内容に限定した。

primaryChecks.text: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Judah was defeated by Israel; so every man fled to his tent.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in God’s house with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 後続節の用例として確認し、この内容は当該節をknownByとする事実へ分離した。

primaryChecks.text: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and also Gimzo and its villages; and they lived there.
primaryChecks.previousContext: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.
primaryChecks.nextContext: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against the LORD.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 後続節の用例として確認し、この内容は当該節をknownByとする事実へ分離した。
